items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-09-30
items.q: He had a strange way, a beautiful way of playing, I thought, Arthur Campbell.

ctx.x: Yeah, I think he made a couple of records on the band.

Yeah, yeah, yeah. He was good too, Arthur Campbell. He had a strange way, a beautiful way of playing, I thought, Arthur Campbell. Lewis Wade, you heard talk of him? Did you hear talk of Lewis Wade? He's a nice player too.
